requirement: A Joomla page.create reply uses the new menu item's URL and keeps its path when the home read is stale

oracle.ref: PR #1342 (fix); fix evidence: Issue #1302: on Joomla with URL rewriting off, the agent returned a bare SEF path that 404ed while the site's menu link using /index.php/<slug> returned 200.
oracle.invariant: The Joomla routing test passes: when an older menu item has the same label, page.create accepts the new item's absolute same-site href https://example.com/index.php/common-questions and verifies /index.php/common-questions. The Joomla stale-home test passes: when the home read lacks the new item, page.create retains /en/common-questions and verifies that path. The test suite exits 0 with 0 failures.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
